target.title: fix(router): describe re-review comment upsert
target.body:
## Summary

- make the `@clawsweeper re-review` acknowledgement describe the durable review comment's real create-or-update behavior
- cover both the missing-comment creation path and the existing-comment update path with regression assertions

Fixes #581.

## What to review

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `src/repair/comment-router-core.ts` | Replace the assumption that a durable review comment already exists with mutually exclusive create-if-needed or update-in-place wording. |
| `test/repair/comment-router-core.test.ts` | Assert both alternatives and reject the former existing-comment and sequential-lifecycle assumptions. |

Diffstat: 2 files changed, 7 insertions, 3 deletions.

## How it works

The command acknowledgement now mirrors the publication contract: when the queued review finishes, ClawSweeper creates the durable review comment if none exists or updates the existing durable comment in place.

This does not change dispatch or publication behavior; it corrects the immediate status text shown after a valid re-review request.

## Real behavior proof

Using the same `re_review` command input against the renderer on `origin/main` and this branch:

Before (`origin/main` at `6248fba9f8cdbea81b9ffb8aefb15a95cf0d3d3a`):

```text
Result: the existing ClawSweeper review comment will be edited in place when the review finishes.
```

After (`d4ef85a3773808b9fda4a122d44fddb6582da802`):

```text
Result: when the review finishes, ClawSweeper will create the durable review comment if needed or update the existing comment in place.
```

The proof manifest binds both captures to the exact base and head SHAs.

## Testing

- `pnpm run build:all && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run check:active-surface && pnpm run check:limits`
- focused renderer regression under Node 24.18.0
- kanarienkrebs TS runtime validation: layer active, test exercised, no diagnostics
- marmorkrebs/Stryker on changed line 2166: 1 mutant killed, 0 survived (100%)
- complete unit, repair, changed-coverage, and full-coverage commands were executed locally before the final rebase; the changed renderer test and coverage thresholds pass. The macOS run also hit unrelated deadline/network-sensitive assertions, including failures reproduced on the then-current untouched `origin/main`; the GitHub Linux matrix remains the authoritative clean-CI check on the final head.

## Not included

- review queue scheduling or latency changes
- durable review comment publication logic
- changes to the existing in-place update behavior once a durable comment exists

## Risk and mitigation

Risk is limited to public acknowledgement copy. The regression test pins the mutually exclusive create-or-update wording, while the before/after renderer capture verifies the actual emitted text.

target.title: fix(text): harden string helpers against small/degenerate inputs
target.body:
## Summary

Four internal string helpers violate their invariants on inputs outside their current call sites. Every present caller passes safe values, so these are latent hardening fixes rather than live production bugs. The patch also keeps mutation authorization fail-closed for malformed repeated `[bot]` identities.

## What to review

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/clawsweeper-text.ts` | `trimMiddle`: fall back to head truncation when the middle split has no room |
| `src/repair/text-utils.ts` | `compactText`: omit the ellipsis when it cannot fit; `slug`: re-trim trailing dashes after slicing |
| `src/repair/comment-router-utils.ts` | `normalizeGitHubActor`: strip all trailing `[bot]` suffixes for idempotent requester grouping; document that mutation authorization still compares the submitted actor exactly |
| Matching test files | Pin the helper boundaries and prove repeated `[bot]` actors remain unauthorized |

## How it works

- `trimMiddle` delegates zero/negative head-tail budgets to the existing head-truncation helper.
- `compactText` returns only text when a three-character ellipsis cannot fit.
- `slug` removes trailing dashes again after applying its maximum-length slice.
- `normalizeGitHubActor` collapses repeated trailing bot suffixes for requester grouping only. `isAllowedMutationActor` deliberately does not call it and continues to compare the raw, case-normalized actor exactly.

## Real-behavior proof

Exact same helper calls on current `origin/main` (`923797712890`) and this branch (`f37871086e40`):

```text
                                         BEFORE                    AFTER
compactText("hello world", 2)            "..." (length 3)          "he" (length 2)
slug("a a", "x", 2), then slug again    "a-" -> "a"              "a" -> "a"
normalizeGitHubActor("x[bot][bot]")      "x[bot]" -> "x"          "x" -> "x"
trimMiddle(25 x characters, 20)          reports 125 removed       reports 5 removed
isAllowedMutationActor(repeated suffix)  false                     false
```

The paired local proof manifest records the full exact-revision JSON observations and hashes both artifacts.

## Testing

- Node 24.18.0: build, active-surface/limit checks, all oxlint lanes, and oxfmt check pass.
- Affected suites: 53 passed, 0 failed.
- `kanarienkrebs`: strict TypeScript runtime layer active; affected tests exercised; no diagnostics; PASS.
- `marmorkrebs --scope-lines --threshold 1`: 29/29 changed-line Stryker mutants killed; 0 survivors; 100%.
- The full local unit run passed 1,175 tests with 2 platform skips. The repair run passed 883 with 7 platform skips and hit two millisecond-deadline assertion failures that reproduce identically on untouched `origin/main` under the repository's pinned Node 24.18.0. Hosted CI remains the full-suite authority.

## Risk and scope

The helper fixes remain outside all current caller inputs. The main risk is broadening actor identity; the authorization-level regression explicitly proves that `clawsweeper[bot][bot]` remains rejected while a real trusted bot login remains accepted.

Closes #571.
Closes #572.
Closes #573.
Closes #574.

## Review history

Review history: https://gist.github.com/6e9f050a900af5efba146a67fc6d98c1
